title: Brokkr evidence archive v1
description: Decision 0105 ruling 2, minted under decision 0082: the inventory `brokkr evidence retire --archived-to <dir>` writes last into the archive directory, after every artifact the historical root holds has been verified, copied to `sha256/<hex>`, and verified again. It names the artifact root retired, every digest and its bytes, the total, the engine's version that wrote it, and when. A file with this shape is the archive's completeness mark: a directory that holds copies and no inventory is an interrupted archive. A present inventory that does not read as this format refuses by name, never as absent; reading archived bytes back is not part of this contract.

format.description: The one format string this build writes and reads. A change a previous build could not read takes a new string, as brokkr.journal-backup.v1 does.

root.description: The artifact root the historical record names, as it resolved when it first protected evidence. The archive holds that root's `sha256/<hex>` artifacts; the root itself is kept, not moved.

engine.description: The engine version that wrote the inventory (the workspace's crate version), never the operator's or a driver's.

archived_at.description: When the archive was taken, RFC 3339 UTC, passed in by the verb rather than read by the runtime.

artifacts.description: Every artifact the root held, one entry per digest, sorted by digest so the inventory is deterministic.

sha256.description: The artifact's name under `sha256/`, which its bytes digest to before and after the copy.

bytes.description: The artifact's length in bytes, as the copy is verified.

total_bytes.description: The sum of every listed artifact's `bytes`.
